prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training recovery with high carbohydrate intake and proper meal timing around long run

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers full day with at least 4 meals/snacks spread across morning, pre-training, post-training, and evening
Includes high carbohydrate content appropriate for endurance athlete (approximately 8-10g per kg body weight daily)
Respects vegetarian diet and excludes nuts
Provides specific timing recommendations for meals relative to training session
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a professional endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high carbohydrate intake and recovery nutrition spread across multiple meals with specific timing around training sessions
